label: A NECESSARY_1 being, one that cannot not-be, is in act as to being, from incorruptibility
meaning: A necessary being cannot fail to be in substance, because whatever can fail to be in substance possibly is not (STMT-CAN-FAIL-TO-BE-IS-POSSIBLY-NOT), and it is not possible that a necessary being is not; so it is simply incorruptible, and the Metaphysics IX reading that incorruptibles as such are in act in substance (STMT-INCORRUPTIBLE-IS-IN-ACT-IN-SUBSTANCE, definition-linked, previously without argument consumer) gives it act as to being. Derives the open bridge STMT-NECESSARY-BEING-HAS-BEING, which reaches the root without a recorded derivation. Act is in the respect of being only, as the source restricts it. Both premises stay open.
